package.name: phm_ood
package.description: Rolling-spread OOD lifecycle node for the Policy Health Monitor with the phm_ood interface: subscribes PolicyEmbedding on a configurable topic, loads an optional .npz calibration, scores the rolling spread against the calibrated threshold with hysteresis (low spread = OOD), and publishes a DetectorVerdict on /phm/verdicts with source 'phm_ood'. Runs the shared C++ implementation from phm_ood_cpp.
